# A09-S201: Model strategy

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

Otherwise it’s going well - there is a lot of fine-tuning and debugging right now, but I am getting control of a beta version for Discord (which everyone can talk to!), and already have an enormous (!) amount of material for Medium.

Right now I am also preparing an application for OpenAI, which must approve the bot before it can be launched. Fortunately it is a process where they contact you and you discuss it. It will be a bit interesting because they have a principled ban on ‘politics’. But by that they mean for example that Venstre or Dansk Folkeparti may not use them to conduct election campaigns. It must be something else with an art project.

And if they should balk at it, I will just transfer the data to EleutherAI’s open-source GPT copy. In that case we have both a story regarding tech giants’ control - and still a chatbot.

An interesting challenge I have run into is different ways to separate a political leader and a political party with AI. If the AI is to be convincing as a political candidate it makes most sense that it is a ‘party’, so I need to make one as leader. I have several ideas about that, but would prefer to discuss with you before I proceed.

[…]
